verdict.rationale: Stagehand can attach over CDP to any Chromium browser you already run (localBrowser.connect), and it offers familiar page methods and APIs, which suggests some interop with existing automation. However, nothing shows that existing Playwright, Puppeteer, or raw CDP code can connect to Stagehand's or Browserbase's managed browsers; the evidence covers only the opposite direction, where Stagehand attaches to your browser. Missing for 10: documented connection of existing Playwright/Puppeteer scripts to Stagehand/Browserbase browsers, an exposed CDP endpoint for managed sessions, code-migration examples, and independent corroboration.
